The three appearances keep their laptop-work, making and resting groupings. Clawd and Dot remain on two workshop stools; Muse and Grok remain near the left leaf scene. No new cast, foreground guest or added text appears.

Canopy framing, curved path, softer pond/bridge distance and directional warm light still join the whole world. The brighter face/laptop grouping leads without requiring every background detail to be decoded.

At420 the foreground laptop activity stays legible; small guest identity and leaf/grip specifics compress into secondary detail. At880/1280 the supporting activities become easier to inspect. This is a useful hierarchy rather than a requirement to zoom.
The hero hand-to-keyboard, seated body/feet, workshop/stool supports and leaf grouping show no new visible contact failure in the inspected whole image and crops.
Warmth and fine garden detail remain after cleanup; the frame does not look like a softened character pasted into an unrelated scene.
baselineComparison: 13 is substantially quieter and more coherent than11 across the full frame, particularly bench wood, tabletop/toolbox, path edges and hero contours. It reaches the cleaner material separation that made07 a useful control while retaining the intended later flat Grok eyes, dark Muse eyes and current story grouping.
